title: Derivation of rho_P from Provenance Event Action on Generated Algebra
problem_from_V1689_8: Arbitrary current-to-endomorphism maps leave high E_Gamma and create scale mismatch. rho_P must be derived from how provenance/source events act on G_p.
core_rule: rho_P is not a fitted embedding. rho_P is the linearized endomorphism induced by ledger events acting on the generated retained algebra G_p.

objects.rho_e: rho_e = dA_e|_{G_p}, the infinitesimal/linearized endomorphism action of event e on G_p
objects.rho_P_J: rho_P(J_P,ij) = signed_sum_{e crossing B_ij} magnitude(e) * rho_e

source_injection.action: adds or strengthens a source generator s_e in S_p and modifies branch availability
source_injection.endomorphism: rho_source(e) = projector onto source-affected branch/source subspace

branch_birth.action: adds a generator b_e to B_p
branch_birth.endomorphism: rho_birth(e) = rank-one insertion/projection into new generator direction

branch_prune.action: removes or suppresses a generator from B_p
branch_prune.endomorphism: rho_prune(e) = negative projector on pruned generator direction

dependency_addition.action: adds a retained-order dependency edge in Pi_p
dependency_addition.endomorphism: rho_dep_add(e) = incidence action on dependency-supported branch pair

dependency_break.action: breaks a dependency relation in Pi_p
dependency_break.endomorphism: rho_dep_break(e) = negative incidence action on broken dependency pair

repair_event.action: restores algebra faithfulness by reducing product/O3/H4 defects
repair_event.endomorphism: rho_repair(e) = projector onto repaired defect subspace

closure_event.action: closes a retained dependency or local recombination relation
closure_event.endomorphism: rho_closure(e) = stabilizer action on closed subspace

order_boundary_crossing.action: moves retained-order dependency across comparison boundary
order_boundary_crossing.endomorphism: rho_order(e) = signed incidence operator respecting ordered_index

provenance_relabel.action: changes label while preserving or breaking lineage
provenance_relabel.endomorphism: rho_label(e) = conjugation/permutation action on provenance-labeled subspace
provenance_relabel.sign: + if lineage conserved, - if lineage broken

mathematical_definition.single_event: rho_e = Proj_target(e) * sigma(e), where Proj_target(e) is the algebra subspace affected by event e and sigma(e) is event orientation/sign.
mathematical_definition.boundary_current: rho_P(J_P,ij) = Σ_{e ∈ Events(B_ij)} sigma(e) magnitude(e) rho_e
mathematical_definition.normalization: rho_P is normalized by boundary algebra scale ||G_i||_alg, not by E_Gamma or D_Gamma R_Gamma.
mathematical_definition.forbidden: rho_P may not depend on R_Gamma, D_Gamma R_Gamma, E_Gamma, weak_target, or fitted coefficients.

subspace_construction.source_projector: P_S(e) derived from source-affected branch/source vector
subspace_construction.repair_projector: P_repair can act on product/O3/H4 defect subspaces, but must be constructed before E_Gamma.

claim_condition.validity: E_Gamma may be tested only after rho_P is generated from event actions and null pipelines regenerate full ledgers upstream.

killer_nulls_specific_to_rho.N_event_action_shuffle: preserve event counts/magnitudes but assign events to wrong affected algebra subspaces; should break rho_P alignment.
killer_nulls_specific_to_rho.N_order_reverse: reverse event orientation sigma(e); should break source-balanced identity in active-order regimes.
killer_nulls_specific_to_rho.N_projector_shuffle: preserve projector norms but shuffle branch/O3/H4 target subspaces; should break identity while preserving scalar distributions.
killer_nulls_specific_to_rho.N_current_zero: zero rho_P in active-source regimes; should fail if source-balanced closure is real.

execution_preconditions_for_V1689_10: Each provenance event must declare affected_subspace_id.
Each affected subspace must be constructible from B_p, O3_p, H4_perp_p, S_p, Pi_p before curvature residuals.
rho_P table must include event-level rho_e terms before aggregation.
Null pipelines must regenerate event-action maps upstream.
claim_boundary: Derivation protocol only; no validation run and no law claim.
